item.title: St. Paul mayor signs ordinance to prohibit ICE from being on city property
item.description: An ordinance to keep Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents off of city-owned property has been signed by St. Paul Mayor Kaohly Her. St. Paul ordinance in response to ICE activity The ordinance was signed Thursday by Her after it was passed by the St. Paul City Council. According to Her, the ordinance prohibits federal law enforcement from staging and having operational activity on city-owned property. It also restricts access to non-public cry spaces.
